highlights: Read Brannock marked its tenth year, with 29 of the county's 31 elementary schools now using shared kindergarten through third grade literacy screeners.
The Foundation co-hosted a statewide convening on clinical teacher preparation with education leaders from 14 districts.
Twenty-one grants were awarded across the fall 2025 and spring 2026 cycles.
Brannock County Schools expanded its literacy coaching network to every elementary school.
The Foundation funded its first assistant principal accelerator cohort at the state level.
Sixteen grants were awarded across the fall 2024 and spring 2025 cycles.
The Board welcomed Dr. Renee Callahan's first full year as Executive Director.
Summer learning partners served students at eleven Brannock County elementary schools.
Fourteen grants were awarded across the fall 2023 and spring 2024 cycles.
The Foundation began a national search for its next Executive Director.
Read Brannock published its first community literacy scorecard.
Thirteen grants were awarded across the fall 2022 and spring 2023 cycles.
